verses.he: לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ לְדָוִ֣ד מִזְמ֑וֹר אֱלֹהֵ֥י תְ֝הִלָּתִ֗י אַֽל־תֶּחֱרַֽשׁ׃
verses.en: For the Leader. A Psalm of David. O God of my praise, keep not silence;

verses.he: כִּ֤י פִ֪י רָשָׁ֡ע וּֽפִי־מִ֭רְמָה עָלַ֣י פָּתָ֑חוּ דִּבְּר֥וּ אִ֝תִּ֗י לְשׁ֣וֹן שָֽׁקֶר׃
verses.en: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit have they opened against me; They have spoken unto me with a lying tongue.

verses.he: וְדִבְרֵ֣י שִׂנְאָ֣ה סְבָב֑וּנִי וַיִּֽלָּחֲמ֥וּנִי חִנָּֽם׃
verses.en: They compassed me about also with words of hatred, And fought against me without a cause.

verses.he: תַּֽחַת־אַהֲבָתִ֥י יִשְׂטְנ֗וּנִי וַאֲנִ֥י תְפִלָּֽה׃
verses.en: In return for my love they are my adversaries; But I am all prayer.

verses.he: וַיָּ֘שִׂ֤ימוּ עָלַ֣י רָ֭עָה תַּ֣חַת טוֹבָ֑ה וְ֝שִׂנְאָ֗ה תַּ֣חַת אַהֲבָתִֽי׃
verses.en: And they have laid upon me evil for good, And hatred for my love:

verses.he: הַפְקֵ֣ד עָלָ֣יו רָשָׁ֑ע וְ֝שָׂטָ֗ן יַעֲמֹ֥ד עַל־יְמִינֽוֹ׃
verses.en: ’Set Thou a wicked man over him; And let an adversary stand at his right hand.

verses.he: בְּ֭הִשָּׁ֣פְטוֹ יֵצֵ֣א רָשָׁ֑ע וּ֝תְפִלָּת֗וֹ תִּהְיֶ֥ה לַֽחֲטָאָֽה׃
verses.en: When he is judged, let him go forth condemned; And let his prayer be turned into sin.

verses.he: יִֽהְיֽוּ־יָמָ֥יו מְעַטִּ֑ים פְּ֝קֻדָּת֗וֹ יִקַּ֥ח אַחֵֽר׃
verses.en: Let his days be few; Let another take his charge.

verses.he: יִֽהְיוּ־בָנָ֥יו יְתוֹמִ֑ים וְ֝אִשְׁתּוֹ אַלְמָנָֽה׃
verses.en: Let his children be fatherless, And his wife a widow.

verses.he: וְנ֤וֹעַ יָנ֣וּעוּ בָנָ֣יו וְשִׁאֵ֑לוּ וְ֝דָרְשׁ֗וּ מֵחָרְבוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.en: Let his children be vagabonds, and beg; And let them seek their bread out of their desolate places.

verses.he: יְנַקֵּ֣שׁ נ֭וֹשֶׁה לְכָל־אֲשֶׁר־ל֑וֹ וְיָבֹ֖זּוּ זָרִ֣ים יְגִיעֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Let the creditor distrain all that he hath; And let strangers make spoil of his labour.

verses.he: אַל־יְהִי־ל֖וֹ מֹשֵׁ֣ךְ חָ֑סֶד וְֽאַל־יְהִ֥י ח֝וֹנֵ֗ן לִיתוֹמָֽיו׃
verses.en: Let there be none to extend kindness unto him; Neither let there be any to be gracious unto his fatherless children.

verses.he: יְהִֽי־אַחֲרִית֥וֹ לְהַכְרִ֑ית בְּד֥וֹר אַ֝חֵ֗ר יִמַּ֥ח שְׁמָֽם׃
verses.en: Let his posterity be cut off; In the generation following let their name be blotted out.

verses.he: יִזָּכֵ֤ר׀ עֲו‍ֹ֣ן אֲ֭בֹתָיו אֶל־יְהוָ֑ה וְחַטַּ֥את אִ֝מּ֗וֹ אַל־תִּמָּֽח׃
verses.en: Let the iniquity of his fathers be brought to remembrance unto the LORD; And let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.

verses.he: יִהְי֣וּ נֶֽגֶד־יְהוָ֣ה תָּמִ֑יד וְיַכְרֵ֖ת מֵאֶ֣רֶץ זִכְרָֽם׃
verses.en: Let them be before the LORD continually, That He may cut off the memory of them from the earth.

verses.he: יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֤ר׀ לֹ֥א זָכַר֮ עֲשׂ֪וֹת חָ֥סֶד וַיִּרְדֹּ֡ף אִישׁ־עָנִ֣י וְ֭אֶבְיוֹן וְנִכְאֵ֨ה לֵבָ֬ב לְמוֹתֵֽת׃
verses.en: Because that he remembered not to do kindness, But persecuted the poor and needy man, And the broken in heart he was ready to slay.

verses.he: וַיֶּאֱהַ֣ב קְ֭לָלָה וַתְּבוֹאֵ֑הוּ וְֽלֹא־חָפֵ֥ץ בִּ֝בְרָכָ֗ה וַתִּרְחַ֥ק מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.en: Yea, he loved cursing, and it came unto him; And he delighted not in blessing, and it is far from him.

verses.he: וַיִּלְבַּ֥שׁ קְלָלָ֗ה כְּמַ֫דּ֥וֹ וַתָּבֹ֣א כַמַּ֣יִם בְּקִרְבּ֑וֹ וְ֝כַשֶּׁ֗מֶן בְּעַצְמוֹתָֽיו׃
verses.en: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his raiment, And it is come into his inward parts like water, And like oil into his bones.

verses.he: תְּהִי־ל֖וֹ כְּבֶ֣גֶד יַעְטֶ֑ה וּ֝לְמֵ֗זַח תָּמִ֥יד יַחְגְּרֶֽהָ׃
verses.en: Let it be unto him as the garment which he putteth on, And for the girdle wherewith he is girded continually.'

verses.he: זֹ֤את פְּעֻלַּ֣ת שֹׂ֭טְנַי מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וְהַדֹּבְרִ֥ים רָ֝֗ע עַל־נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.en: This would mine adversaries effect from the LORD, And they that speak evil against my soul.

verses.he: וְאַתָּ֤ה׀ יְה֘וִ֤ה אֲדֹנָ֗י עֲ‍ֽשֵׂה־אִ֭תִּי לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמֶ֑ךָ כִּי־ט֥וֹב חַ֝סְדְּךָ֗ הַצִּילֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: But Thou, O GOD the Lord, deal with me for Thy name's sake; Because Thy mercy is good, deliver Thou me.

verses.he: כִּֽי־עָנִ֣י וְאֶבְי֣וֹן אָנֹ֑כִי וְ֝לִבִּ֗י חָלַ֥ל בְּקִרְבִּֽי׃
verses.en: For I am poor and needy, And my heart is wounded within me.

verses.he: כְּצֵל־כִּנְטוֹת֥וֹ נֶהֱלָ֑כְתִּי נִ֝נְעַ֗רְתִּי כָּֽאַרְבֶּֽה׃
verses.en: I am gone like the shadow when it lengtheneth; I am shaken off as the locust.

verses.he: בִּ֭רְכַּי כָּשְׁל֣וּ מִצּ֑וֹם וּ֝בְשָׂרִ֗י כָּחַ֥שׁ מִשָּֽׁמֶן׃
verses.en: My knees totter through fasting; And my flesh is lean, and hath no fatness.

verses.he: וַאֲנִ֤י׀ הָיִ֣יתִי חֶרְפָּ֣ה לָהֶ֑ם יִ֝רְא֗וּנִי יְנִיע֥וּן רֹאשָֽׁם׃
verses.en: I am become also a taunt unto them; When they see me, they shake their head.

verses.he: עָ֭זְרֵנִי יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑י ה֭וֹשִׁיעֵ֣נִי כְחַסְדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.en: Help me, O LORD my God; O save me according to Thy mercy;

verses.he: וְֽ֭יֵדְעוּ כִּי־יָ֣דְךָ זֹּ֑את אַתָּ֖ה יְהוָ֣ה עֲשִׂיתָֽהּ׃
verses.en: That they may know that this is Thy hand; That Thou, LORD, hast done it.

verses.he: יְקַֽלְלוּ־הֵמָּה֮ וְאַתָּ֪ה תְבָ֫רֵ֥ךְ קָ֤מוּ׀ וַיֵּבֹ֗שׁוּ וְֽעַבְדְּךָ֥ יִשְׂמָֽח׃
verses.en: Let them curse, but bless Thou; When they arise, they shall be put to shame, but Thy servant shall rejoice.

verses.he: יִלְבְּשׁ֣וּ שׂוֹטְנַ֣י כְּלִמָּ֑ה וְיַעֲט֖וּ כַמְעִ֣יל בָּשְׁתָּֽם׃
verses.en: Mine adversaries shall be clothed with confusion, And shall put on their own shame as a robe.

verses.he: א֘וֹדֶ֤ה יְהוָ֣ה מְאֹ֣ד בְּפִ֑י וּבְת֖וֹךְ רַבִּ֣ים אֲהַֽלְלֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.en: I will give great thanks unto the LORD with my mouth; Yea, I will praise Him among the multitude;

verses.he: כִּֽי־יַ֭עֲמֹד לִימִ֣ין אֶבְי֑וֹן לְ֝הוֹשִׁ֗יעַ מִשֹּׁפְטֵ֥י נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.en: Because He standeth at the right hand of the needy, To save him from them that judge his soul.
